description: Source code for CodeMirror SQL mode, defining syntax highlighting and parsing rules for various SQL dialects.

methods.name: tokenBase
methods.description: Tokenizes base SQL syntax elements such as numbers, strings, comments, operators, and keywords.

methods.name: tokenLiteral
methods.description: Handles string literal tokenization with escape sequences.

methods.name: tokenComment
methods.description: Handles multi-line comment tokenization with nested comments support.

methods.name: pushContext
methods.description: Pushes a new parsing context onto the context stack.

methods.name: popContext
methods.description: Pops the current parsing context from the context stack.
